title: Insurance Churn Analytics Template: Automated End-to-End Notebook, Report Generator and QA Toolkit
description:
An end-to-end, data-agnostic analytics template for insurance customer churn (lapse, surrender, non-renewal). A single Jupyter notebook ingests messy tabular data (CSV, Excel, JSON, Parquet; corrupted headers, mixed types, Indonesian number formats, leakage traps) and runs statistical driver analysis, survival analysis (Kaplan-Meier, Cox, AFT, RMST, persistency ratios), interpretable regression, a cross-validated machine-learning ensemble with DeLong and profit-based (EMPC) evaluation, doubly robust causal inference with uplift modelling, and campaign economics under a budget. It writes a formatted article (main text plus appendices with numbered equations), an interactive dashboard and a submission file.

Tooling covers case setup from a casebook, research planning, headless execution, stress testing on 44 data variants, automatic article QA and an AI-writing-style audit. Validated end to end on a fictional insurance case.
